title: Late Breaking Results: FPGen-3D: Automated Framework for 3D-FPGA Architecture Generation and Exploration
problem: FPGA design space exploration is limited by 2D constraints; exploring 3D FPGA architectures with vertical connections requires manual and tedious design efforts, preventing efficient navigation of 3D design space.
motivation: 3D FPGAs promise reduced wire length and improved performance, but lack automated tools for architecture generation and design space exploration.
method: FPGen-3D automates 3D FPGA architecture generation from user-defined parameters, producing synthesizable RTL, routing results, and programming bitstreams. Explores vertical connection strategies via 3D switch blocks (SB) and 3D configurable logic blocks (CLB).
key_novelty: Automated framework for 3D FPGA architecture generation enabling systematic exploration of vertical connection strategies (3D SB and CLB designs).
contributions: Automated framework for 3D FPGA architecture generation
Synthesizable RTL generation from architectural parameters
18.5% wire length reduction vs 2D FPGAs through 3D vertical connections
primary_theme: Automated 3D FPGA architecture generation and exploration framework
